Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — product looked great and the team is excited about the performance numbers. Procurement asked me to kick off the DPA conversation so we can hit our internal vendor cut-off next week (10/01). Two quick asks from my side:

- Can Redwood sign our standard DPA with the attached questionnaire filled out? I attached FinWell_DPA_Request.pdf with a few required fields (retention, subprocessors, SCCs acceptance).
- If Redwood has a standard DPA, please share it and let us know typical turnaround for redlines + e-sign.

Procurement will want a mutual action plan (timeline + who signs). Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Hi Lila — thanks for sending this over and for the quick turnaround.

We can absolutely support a standard DPA flow and should be able to meet a 10/01 target if we lock down scope this week. Next steps I propose:

1) I’m attaching Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf — this is our standard DPA (we include SCCs by reference and can execute the European addendum where required).
2) Marissa (cc’d) from legal ops will triage your questionnaire and produce a short cover note mapping our answers to your required fields.
3) If there are a couple of minor redlines, we can consolidate and route for e-sign via DocuSign; if there are material changes we’ll need legal review and will flag timelines.

Quick questions for procurement: do you need a data residency carve-out (EU-only processing) or is SCCs + standard controls sufficient? Also, can procurement accept Redwood’s standard e-sign workflow (DocuSign envelope) or do you require in-person signatory verification?

I’ll aim to have the consolidated answers and our DPA back to you by EOD Monday (9/24).

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf (PDF, 112 KB)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Lead — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Lila Morgan <lila.morgan@finwell.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finwell.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Sep 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA: privacy confirmation and timelines

Neha — thanks for the fast response. A couple of clarifications after reviewing Redwood_DPA_v1:

- Retention: Procurement is asking for a 2-year retention cap on logs for vendor analytics. Can you confirm Redwood can commit to config that restricts retention to 2 years for customer-level logs?
- SCCs: FinWell requires explicit mention that SCCs will be executed where EU personal data is processed. The reference is OK but Procurement wants a short addendum line acknowledging this.
- E-sign: DocuSign is fine, but we need the primary signatory to be C-level (VP Procurement or above).

I attached a marked redline with the minimal edits we need for procurement to greenlight. If you can return a consolidated v2 for DocuSign by Monday morning we can proceed with internal approvals.

Attachment: FinWell_DPA_Redline.pdf (PDF, 34 KB)

Thanks,
Lila

Hi Lila — appreciate the clear redline and procurement constraints.

On next steps:

- Marissa has consolidated your redline and our standard language; attached is Redwood_DPA_Consolidated_v2.pdf which includes:
  - A configurable retention clause that documents how to set a 2-year maximum for customer event logs (we can operationalize this via retention policy for account data).
  - An explicit SCCs addendum paragraph that we’ll include when EU processing is in scope.
  - Signature block updated to allow VP Procurement or above as counterparty signee.

- I’ve created a DocuSign envelope and included the HubSpot deal link so procurement and legal can track the envelope and the purchase order. Please confirm the primary signatory name and email so we route to the right person.

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Consolidated_v2.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)

If everything looks acceptable I’ll ask Marissa to trigger the DocuSign flow and loop in our finance team for the PO. If procurement needs a 15-min call to sign off, I’m available tomorrow at 0900 PT.
